content: docker compose depends_on conditions are evaluated ONCE at stack up - they are start ordering, not supervision. A DB restarting later does not re-trigger service_healthy and Compose does not restart dependents; apps need own reconnect logic. start_period is a grace window where failures do NOT count toward retries; first success ends it immediately. Worst-case time-to-unhealthy = start_period + retries*(interval+timeout) - size deploy timeouts to this. Raise start_period (not retries) for slow JVM starts. Healthchecks run INSIDE the container against the CONTAINER port: binaries must exist in image (alpine=busybox wget, no curl on many images), and checking the published host port always fails.
